start_here: Say to your AI: "I saved the made-up iron fact sheet as raw/iron.html in my gate folder, so make the plain-text copy my claims are checked against." It runs the script on your sources file and tells you each source's extract and its length.
no_lists_because: It reads a sources file and the raw files beside it and writes extract files; it names no list of yours.
instructions: 1. Save each source you cite in a folder (for example gate/raw/iron.html) and write gate/sources.json: {"sources": {"iron-sheet": {"raw": "raw/iron.html", "extract": "html", "text": "iron.txt"}}}. The extract kind is html, fdc-json, new-order or copy.

2. Read the tool's row with tools:list {tool: "tool:make-plain-text-extracts-of-claim-sources"}, then from the root of the Workshop checkout run its command with {request} set to a file holding {"sources": "gate/sources.json"}.

3. Read the last line: {"result": {"sources": [{"id", "text", "chars"}]}}. A kind made by its own tool (such as whisper-words) shows kept: true, and is refused with an error when its extract file is missing.
4. Run tool:check-every-claim-against-its-facts-and-sources next: it checks each quoted wording against these extracts.

worked_examples.title: A web page becomes one line of plain text
worked_examples.ask: Make the plain-text copy of my iron fact sheet source.
worked_examples.given:
From tools/check-every-claim-against-its-facts-and-sources/test/test_claim_check.py and test/fixture_world.py: the AI then runs `python3 -I tools/check-every-claim-against-its-facts-and-sources/do-work/make_source_extracts.py < request.json` from the checkout root, where request.json is {"sources": "gate/sources.json"}, gate/sources.json is {"sources": {"iron-sheet": {"raw": "raw/iron.html", "extract": "html", "text": "iron.txt"}}} and gate/raw/iron.html is

Iron, Fact Sheet (made up). Adults 19-50 years 18 mg a day. Spinach, 1 cup cooked 6 mg. Lentils, 1 cup cooked 6.6 mg.

.
worked_examples.hands_back: The style block and tags are dropped and gate/iron.txt holds the line "Iron, Fact Sheet (made up). Adults 19-50 years 18 mg a day. Spinach, 1 cup cooked 6 mg. Lentils, 1 cup cooked 6.6 mg." and a newline. The last printed line is {"result": {"sources": [{"id": "iron-sheet", "text": "gate/iron.txt", "chars": 118}]}}.
